1: // Simple Neon Wave game
2: // Canvas with id="game" assumed in HTML
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Ship definition
11:   const ship = {
12:     width: 30,
13:     height: 15,
14:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 15,
15:     y: canvas.height - 20,
16:     speed: 4,
17:     color: '#0ff',
18:     moveLeft: false,
19:     moveRight: false,
20:     update() {
21:       if (this.moveLeft) this.x -= this.speed;
22:       if (this.moveRight) this.x += this.speed;
23:       // Keep ship within canvas bounds
24:       this.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.x, canvas.width - this.width));
25:     },
26:     draw() {
27:       ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
28:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
29:     }
30:   };
31: 
32:   // Obstacle definition
33:   const obstacles = [];
34:   const obstacleConfig = {
35:     width: 40,
36:     height: 20,
37:     speed: 2,
38:     spawnInterval: 1200, // ms
39:     color: '#f0f'
40:   };
41: 
42:   function spawnObstacle() {
43:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - obstacleConfig.width);
44:     const y = canvas.height; // start at bottom
45:     obstacles.push({ x, y, width: obstacleConfig.width, height: obstacleConfig.height });
46:   }
47: 
48:   function updateObstacles() {
49:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
50:       const o = obstacles[i];
51:       o.y -= obstacleConfig.speed; // move up
52:       if (o.y + o.height < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
53:     }
54:   }
55: 
56:   function drawObstacles() {
57:     ctx.fillStyle = obstacleConfig.color;
58:     obstacles.forEach(o => ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.width, o.height));
59:   }
60: 
61:   function checkCollision() {
62:     for (const o of obstacles) {
63:       if (
64:         ship.x < o.x + o.width &&
65:         ship.x + ship.width > o.x &&
66:         ship.y < o.y + o.height &&
67:         ship.y + ship.height > o.y
68:       ) {
69:         return true;
70:       }
71:     }
72:     // Lose if ship falls off bottom (shouldn't happen, but keep spec)
73:     if (ship.y + ship.height > canvas.height) return true;
74:     return false;
75:   }
76: 
77:   let gameOver = false;
78:   function gameLoop() {
79:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
80:     ship.update();
81:     ship.draw();
82:     updateObstacles();
83:     drawObstacles();
84:     if (checkCollision()) {
85:       gameOver = true;
86:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
87:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
88:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
89:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
90:       return;
91:     }
92:     requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
93:   }
94: 
95:   // Input handling
96:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
97:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.moveLeft = true;
98:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.moveRight = true;
99:   });
100:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
101:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.moveLeft = false;
102:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.moveRight = false;
103:   });
104: 
105:   // Start spawning obstacles
106:   const spawnTimer = setInterval(() => {
107:     if (!gameOver) spawnObstacle();
108:     else clearInterval(spawnTimer);
109:   }, obstacleConfig.spawnInterval);
110: 
111:   // Kick off the game
112:   requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
